info.title: Verified Service Marketplace — Milestone A
info.description: Milestone A contract. Authentication endpoints are implemented; organization, profile and provider-verification endpoints remain planned. Browser sessions use HttpOnly cookies; all auth POSTs require X-CSRF-Token including anonymous registration, login, verification and resend. Fetch a fresh token after identity changes. Protected organizational routes enforce active membership. Strong ETags protect mutable business resources. Decisions, audit and outbox commit atomically. Partner OAuth belongs to Milestone C.
